propositions: Forty-five ambient config/credential reads (12 REBAR_ROOT, 17 load_config, 7 dynamic env, 3 identity, 2 tuning, 4 toggles) exist below the reconciler seam and are flagged by check_config_ownership.py AST gate

The reconciler must thread root and typed Config objects composed ONCE at pass entry (before _load_snapshots/run_differs) via _PassContext so all below-seam consumers receive values instead of ambient reads

Forty-one reads (REBAR_ROOT, load_config, RECONCILER_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE, identity accessors, and dead/rewired dynamic env reads) must be cut-to-seam through owned config.py/_config_sources.py resolvers

Four owned-in-place reads (REBAR_RECONCILER_LOCK_STEAL, REBAR_RECONCILER_WRITE_FACADE, REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP, REBAR_RECONCILER_CONFLICT_PARENT_ID) must retain # read-via: markers because they are kill-switches, rollback toggles, or per-operation live overrides—capped at exactly 6 marked lines

Three identity reads (last_pass.resolve_environment_id, last_pass publish passthrough, inbound_translate defaults) must keep distinct per-call-site owned semantics rather than unifying to a single accessor

Shared helpers (_engine_support/reads, lookups, gates, bridge_fsck L692) and pre-pass callers (_advisory_lock, _preflight) must resolve/thread the composition root instead of ambient reads while maintaining unchanged external signatures
